capabilities: Create a corkboard file for any folder via context menu or command
Edit card synopses, status labels, and colors inline
Reorder, multi-select, and rename cards by drag and click
Sync the board automatically with file creations, renames, moves, and deletions
Push card synopses into the underlying markdown files
extras: Desktop only (mobile unsupported); not yet on the community plugin list, so it must be installed manually from build or release artifacts; lists known v0.1.0 limits such as a stub rebind feature and no undo/redo.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in folder-level card view for outlining notes with synopses, statuses, and reordering.
summary: Scrivener-style corkboard that renders each folder's markdown notes as draggable index cards in an index.corkboard JSON file.
